title: Settings file osfsettings.json could not be loaded
impact: The mod that provides this file has no settings page, hotkeys or menu cards in OSF Settings.
nextSteps: Update or reinstall the mod that provides this file.
note: The file's full path is in OSF Settings.log.

title: OSF UI update recommended
impact: Mods that use OSF UI ask for a newer release. Some of their features may not work until you update it.
nextSteps: Update OSF UI to 2.1.0 or later.
note: This is an advisory check. Follow each mod's installation instructions for compatibility.

title: sample-pack is missing
impact: Mods that use sample-pack cannot find it. Some of their features may not work until you install it.
reason: No settings manifest named sample-pack.json was found in the active installation.
note: This is an advisory check. Follow each mod's installation instructions for compatibility.

title: Scene playback unavailable
impact: Scenes cannot start until the required animation files are available.
nextSteps: Check that the required animation pack is installed and enabled, then restart the game.

title: Optional animation pack missing
impact: Some additional scenes are unavailable. Other features continue to work.
nextSteps: Install the optional pack if you want to use those scenes.

title: A report with no additional details
A longer report to check reading and scrolling
impact:
This development fixture exercises long issue text in both menu sizes. Its title and body should wrap without overlapping another section. The complete report remains readable even when it is taller than the detail pane.

The issue list stays focused while you scroll the details. Mouse-wheel input over this pane must not move selection in the list. Keyboard Page Up and Page Down, and the displayed controller scroll controls, should reach all of the text.
nextSteps:
Scroll to the end of this report, then select a different issue. The new issue should start at the top.

If the same issue is updated, keep its selection and preserve the reading position where possible. If it is cleared, select a nearby remaining issue. If all reports are cleared, show No issues reported.

END OF LONG REPORT
